axi_crossbar_addr.summary: AXI crossbar address decoder: a two-state FSM decodes the slave address into master select/region or decode error, enforcing outstanding-transaction and per-ID thread limits tracked by counters.

blocks.name: Decode controller
blocks.description: IDLE/DECODE FSM issuing address, write command and reply command handshakes.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DECODE controller: decodes address, issues outputs, waits for handshakes before aready.

anchors.name: s_axi_avalid
anchors.why: Address valid starting a decode in IDLE.

anchors.name: s_axi_aready
anchors.why: Registered address ready pulsed after all outputs handshake.

anchors.name: m_axi_avalid
anchors.why: Decoded address valid toward selected master.

anchors.name: m_axi_aready
anchors.why: Master address ready clearing address valid.

anchors.name: m_wc_valid
anchors.why: Write command valid carrying select and decerr when WC_OUTPUT.

anchors.name: m_rc_valid
anchors.why: Reply command valid issued on decode error.

blocks.name: Address decoder
blocks.description: Compares address/prot to master regions, yields select, region and decerr.

anchors.name: s_axi_aaddr
anchors.why: Slave address compared against master base addresses to select destination.

anchors.name: m_select
anchors.why: Decoded destination master index steering the crossbar.

anchors.name: m_axi_aregion
anchors.why: Decoded region index within selected master.

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Address matched a permitted master region; chooses issue versus decode error.

anchors.name: m_decerr_reg
anchors.why: Decode error flag on no-match, sent to write and reply command outputs.

blocks.name: Transaction tracking
blocks.description: Global outstanding counter and per-ID thread table enforcing accept and ordering limits.

anchors.name: trans_count_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding transaction count, incremented on start, decremented on completion.

anchors.name: trans_limit
anchors.why: Outstanding limit reached; blocks new decode issue.

anchors.name: trans_start
anchors.why: Transaction issue pulse updating counters and thread table.

anchors.name: thread_id_reg
anchors.why: Per-thread table of active IDs with destination, preserving ID ordering.

anchors.name: thread_count_reg
anchors.why: Per-thread outstanding count; nonzero marks thread active.

anchors.name: thread_match
anchors.why: Incoming ID matches an active thread.

anchors.name: thread_match_dest
anchors.why: Matching thread targets same master/region, allowing issue.

anchors.name: s_cpl_valid
anchors.why: Completion strobe decrementing transaction and thread counters.

anchors.name: stage_valid
anchors.why: memory array

anchors.name: stage_enc
anchors.why: memory array

arbiter.summary: Parameterized arbiter: two priority encoders (plain and round-robin-masked) pick a requester, registered into one-hot grant, encoded index and valid, with optional blocking hold.

blocks.name: Grant controller
blocks.description: Next-grant logic and grant registers selecting one requester per cycle.

anchors.name: grant_reg
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector chosen from priority-encoded requests; drives grant port.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Grant valid output from grant_valid_reg; used for blocking hold check.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Binary index of the granted port, from grant_encoded_reg.

anchors.name: request_valid
anchors.why: Any-request flag from priority encoder; enables issuing a new grant.

anchors.name: request_index
anchors.why: Encoded index of highest-priority request, loaded into grant_encoded_next.

blocks.name: Priority encoders
blocks.description: Plain and round-robin-masked priority encoders over requests.

anchors.name: masked_request_valid
anchors.why: Masked-request present flag choosing masked grant in round-robin mode.

anchors.name: mask_reg
anchors.why: Round-robin priority mask applied to requests; inactive with default ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN=0.

ungrouped_anchors.name: request
ungrouped_anchors.why: Per-port request vector fed to both priority encoders.

ungrouped_anchors.name: acknowledge
ungrouped_anchors.why: Per-port acknowledge releasing a held grant in blocking-ack mode.

axi_register_rd.summary: AXI read-channel register slice: AR channel through a simple output register and R channel through a two-entry skid buffer (output plus temp registers) to break timing paths without bubbles.

blocks.name: AR register slice
blocks.description: Simple register stage on the read address channel.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave read address valid, registered toward m_axi_arvalid.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: Slave read address ready from AR register occupancy.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address captured into AR output register.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Registered read address valid toward downstream slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: Downstream address accept clearing the AR register.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Registered read address output.

anchors.name: s_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Burst length passed through AR register.

blocks.name: R skid buffer
blocks.description: Output and temp registers with ready/valid control on read data channel.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp register holding R data when upstream stalls.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_s_axi_rvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp register occupied flag; blocks early ready and feeds output on drain.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid output register holding R data presented on s_axi_rdata.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rvalid_reg
anchors.why: Output register valid driving s_axi_rvalid.

anchors.name: genblk2.m_axi_rready_early
anchors.why: Next-cycle ready computed from output ready and temp occupancy.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_input_to_output
anchors.why: Loads incoming R beat directly into output registers.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_input_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads incoming R beat into temp registers when output stalled.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Selects temp registers as source for output registers.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid from downstream, loaded into output or temp registers.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Registered read ready to downstream from skid buffer state.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data entering the R skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axi_rlast
anchors.why: Last-beat flag passed through R skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid toward upstream master from output register.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Upstream ready deciding output vs temp storage and early ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data output from skid output register.

axi_crossbar_rd.summary: AXI read crossbar: per-slave-port address decoders route AR requests to per-master round-robin arbiters with issue limits, while per-slave-port arbiters mux R responses (plus decode-error responses) back, with register slices on both sides.

blocks.name: Slave port address decode
blocks.description: Per slave port address decoder with admission control, selecting target master.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].a_select
anchors.why: Decoded target master index steering arvalid and aready routing.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_axi_avalid
anchors.why: Decoded address valid shifted onto selected master request line.

anchors.name: int_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave-by-master address request matrix feeding master arbiters.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].s_cpl_valid
anchors.why: Completion of last read beat returned to address decoder thread tracking.

blocks.name: Decode error responder
blocks.description: Generates DECERR read bursts for unmapped addresses.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_rc_valid
anchors.why: Decode-error reply command; starts decode-error response burst.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].decerr_m_axi_rvalid_reg
anchors.why: Decode-error response valid, extra requester to response arbiter.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].decerr_len_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beats of decode-error read burst.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].decerr_m_axi_rlast_reg
anchors.why: Last-beat flag of decode-error burst.

blocks.name: Read response arbitration
blocks.description: Per slave port round-robin arbiter and mux of R responses from masters and decerr.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].r_request
anchors.why: Response requests from each master port and decode error.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].r_grant_encoded
anchors.why: Response arbiter grant index selecting R mux source per slave port.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_axi_rdata_mux
anchors.why: Muxed read data into S-side register slice.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].m_axi_rvalid_mux
anchors.why: Muxed read valid gated by grant_valid.

anchors.name: int_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Master-by-slave response valid matrix feeding response arbiters.

blocks.name: Slave side register slices
blocks.description: Per slave port AR/R register slices.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave-port read address valid into S-side register slices.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: Slave-port read address ready from S-side register slices.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Slave-port read addresses decoded to select master port.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to each slave port.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid to slave ports.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Slave-port read data ready.

blocks.name: Master address arbitration
blocks.description: Per master port round-robin arbiter muxing slave AR requests.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_grant_encoded
anchors.why: Address arbiter grant index selecting slave AR fields for each master port.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].a_request
anchors.why: Address requests to master arbiter, blocked by trans_limit.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].s_axi_araddr_mux
anchors.why: Muxed read address from granted slave into M-side register slice.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].s_axi_arid_mux
anchors.why: Muxed ID extended with slave index for response routing.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].s_axi_arvalid_mux
anchors.why: Granted address valid into M-side register slice.

blocks.name: Issue limit counter
blocks.description: Counts outstanding reads per master port, throttling arbitration.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].trans_count_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding read transactions per master port.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].trans_limit
anchors.why: Issue limit reached; blocks new address requests.

blocks.name: Response routing
blocks.description: Routes master R responses to slave ports by ID upper bits.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].r_select
anchors.why: Slave port index from response ID routing rvalid/rready.

anchors.name: m_axi_rid
anchors.why: Response ID whose upper bits select the originating slave port.

blocks.name: Master side register slices
blocks.description: Per master port AR/R register slices.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Master-port read address valid from M-side register slices.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: Master-port read address ready.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Routed read address to downstream slaves.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from downstream slaves.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Master-port read data valid.
